newsitem.title: USA: Bid for Spreckels is fair - Salomon Bros.
newsitem.headline: Bid for Spreckels is fair - Salomon Bros.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said in a Securities and Exchange Commission filing on Thursday that it found Columbus McKinnon Corp's tender offer for Spreckels Industries Inc to be fair.

In an August 23 letter to the Spreckels board, Salomon said, "The consideration to be received by holders of shares in the offer and the merger was fair, from a financial point of view," according to the filing.
Columbus McKinnon has offered $24 cash per share for Spreckels. The offer is to expire October 9.
Salomon said its opinion was for the benefit of the Spreckels board and did not "constitute a recommendation."
